purpose.zh: 练臀部和肩膀，打开胸口
purpose.en: Build your glutes and shoulders and open your chest.

text.zh: 手和脚跟推地，把屁股抬到和肩膀、膝盖一样高
text.en: Push through hands and heels and lift your hips level with your knees
Point your fingers toward your feet and keep your arms straight.

text.zh: 胸口打开，肩胛骨往中间收。
text.en: Open your chest and draw your shoulder blades together.

commonErrors.en: Not lifting the hips high enough.

cautions.zh: 手腕刺痛或发麻时停止，开始前先活动手腕
cautions.en: Stop if your wrists feel sharp pain or numbness, and warm them up first.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹着疼时，缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.

changes: 口令按相位缩短（0.7 s 起落 → 抬起 / 放下）
手腕 caution 改「X 时 Y」
